title: Can I BEAT Shotgun King? [RANK 2]
summary: iwantcheckmate plays Shotgun King: The Final Checkmate (roguelike), reaching Rank 2: he controls a lone black king with a shotgun against a white army across floors, choosing upgrade/curse cards.
rules: Player is a black king that moves 1 square like a chess king OR fires a shotgun instead of moving.
Shotgun fires a cone spread of pellets; pellets damage/kill white pieces (pieces have HP); limited shells, reload costs a turn (game mechanics, inferred from knowledge of Shotgun King).
White pieces move like chess pieces; if a white piece can capture the king, you die.
Clear a floor by killing the white king; floors count up (FLOOR 5, 7 visible).
Between floors pick cards: an upgrade for you paired with a buff/curse for the white side.
win_condition: Kill the white king on each floor; beat the final floor.
